bio: Seven years shipping React, Next.js, and Node.js applications to production. Co-founded an EU-hosted AI platform, led Web3 DApp development on Polygon, and architected billing pipelines handling 10,000+ daily sessions.

hero.headline: I build web applications that handle real users and real money.
hero.subtitle: Full-stack developer & AI co-founder. React, Next.js, TypeScript, Solidity. Based in Greece.

about.intro: Seven years shipping full-stack applications to production — from AI chat platforms and crypto exchanges to Web3 prediction markets and food-tech. I've co-founded a company, led engineering teams, and written Solidity contracts that settle real money on-chain.
paragraphs: I specialize in building full-stack applications with React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Node.js. My work spans AI-integrated products (LiteLLM, RAG), Web3 DApps (Solidity on Polygon), crypto exchanges, real estate platforms, and food-tech systems.

I co-founded aim2balance.ai — an EU-hosted AI platform with EUR-based billing, Stripe wallets, and a Chrome extension tracking token consumption across ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini. Before that, I led a 3-person team building three products simultaneously at Zoof-it.
Currently based in Greece, available for freelance projects and consulting engagements.
